title: Room Bookings
summary: Room Bookings lets staff book meeting rooms and borrow equipment such as laptops and projectors. The facilities team look after the rooms and kit, approve bookings for the largest rooms, and get a list of the day's bookings each morning.

nodes.label: Staff
nodes.description: Anyone who works here. They book rooms, reserve equipment, and cancel bookings they no longer need.

nodes.label: Facilities team
nodes.description: Keep the list of rooms and equipment up to date, approve bookings for the largest rooms, and hand out and take back borrowed kit.

nodes.label: Room Bookings
nodes.description: The website staff and the facilities team use for everything to do with rooms and equipment.

nodes.label: Room bookings
nodes.description: Staff pick a room and a time. Most bookings are confirmed straight away; the largest rooms need the facilities team's approval first.

nodes.label: Requested
nodes.description: A member of staff has asked for a room at a given time. The app checks the room is free before accepting the request.

nodes.label: Waiting for approval
nodes.description: Bookings for rooms that seat more than forty people wait here until someone in the facilities team approves or declines them.

nodes.label: Confirmed
nodes.description: The room is held. The person who booked it is emailed a confirmation.

nodes.label: Cancelled
nodes.description: Cancelled by the person who booked it, or declined by the facilities team. The room becomes free again.

nodes.label: Kit loans
nodes.description: Staff reserve equipment for a set of days, collect it from the facilities desk, and bring it back.

nodes.label: Reserve
nodes.description: Staff choose the equipment and the days they need it. The app only offers kit that is free for the whole loan.

nodes.label: Collect
nodes.description: The facilities team record the hand-over at the desk, so the app knows who has each item.

nodes.label: Return
nodes.description: The facilities team record the item coming back and note any damage before it can be lent again.

nodes.label: Rooms and kit
nodes.description: The list of bookable rooms, with their size and facilities, and of the equipment that can be borrowed. Only the facilities team can change it.

nodes.label: Calendar feed
nodes.description: Publishes each person's bookings as a link that calendar apps can subscribe to. Possibly no longer in use: the link is not shown anywhere on screen.

nodes.label: Behind the scenes
nodes.description: The parts nobody sees directly: where everything is stored, signing people in, and the emails the app sends on its own.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.description: Holds the rooms, the equipment, and every booking and loan.

nodes.label: Sign-in
nodes.description: Hands signing in to the single sign-on service, so nobody needs a separate password, and keeps the facilities team's extra permissions.

nodes.label: Scheduled jobs
nodes.description: Starts the app's regular jobs at set times without anyone pressing a button.

nodes.label: Daily booking list
nodes.description: Emails the facilities team a list of the day's room bookings and kit collections, so they can set rooms up and have equipment ready.

nodes.label: Booking reminder
nodes.description: An email meant to remind staff the day before a booking, so rooms that are no longer needed get cancelled.
nodes.issue: This email is written but nothing ever sends it, so staff never get a reminder and unwanted bookings are not cancelled.

nodes.label: Single sign-on
nodes.description: The organisation's single sign-on service. Confirms who people are, so the app never handles their passwords.

nodes.label: Mail server
nodes.description: Delivers the app's emails: booking confirmations to staff and the daily booking list to the facilities team.

nodes.label: Calendar apps
nodes.description: People's own calendar apps, which can subscribe to the calendar feed. Possibly no longer in use.
